name: Lying Windshield Wiper
steps: Lie on your back, spread your arms for support and raise both legs together toward the ceiling.
Brace your core firmly and press your palms and shoulder blades into the floor.
Lower both legs together slowly to one side as far as you can while keeping your opposite shoulder blade planted on the ground.
Use your obliques to sweep your legs back through center and lower them to the opposite side, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Bend your knees slightly to shorten the lever if keeping your legs straight strains your lower back.
Control both sides smoothly without dropping your legs into the floor.
